chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu 'Ubaydah, who said:

I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about a man who killed his mother. He said: “He is to be killed for her, in humiliation, and I do not think that his being killed is an expiation, nor does he inherit from her.”

key_terms.أُمَّهُ: his mother; the victim in this ruling
key_terms.صَاغِرًا: in humiliation; in a state of abasement
key_terms.قَتَلَ: killed; unlawfully caused the death of another person
key_terms.كَفَّارَةً: expiation; an act that would atone for the sin
key_terms.يَرِثُهَا: he inherits from her; receives inheritance from the deceased
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: he is to be killed; subject to retaliatory execution

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills his mother in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who kills his mother. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام states that he is subject to retaliation, that his execution is not regarded as an expiation, and that he is barred from inheriting from her.
